description: Fetch each URL and report how its title and meta description will look in a search result: character length, pixel width, whether the engine will truncate it, and the Open Graph and Twitter Card fallbacks. Use it when the user asks how a page "looks in Google" or is rewriting titles and descriptions - it is about the snippet, not the page's other SEO problems, which check_page covers. At most 50 URLs per call; does not count against the page budget; limited to 30 calls a minute.

engine.description:
Search engine whose truncation rules to apply: "google" (default) or
"bing".

urls.description: Absolute URLs to preview. At most 50 per call.

name: serp_preview
